dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are you an adviser? I'm thinking about graduate school, but I don't know where to start.
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːs miː, ər juː ən ədˈvaɪzər? aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈɡrædʒuət ˌskuːl, bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ wɛr tə ˈstɑːrt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am. What field are you interested in?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈæm. ˈwʌt ˈfiːld ər juː ˈɪntrəstɪd ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's the problem. I don't know what to study. I like English, but I also like the environment.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ðə ˈprɑːbləm. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈwʌt tə ˈstʌdi. aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, bʌt aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈlaɪk ði ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Those are both good fields. You have a few options.
dialogue.reading: ˈðoʊz ər ˈboʊθ ˈɡʊd ˈfiːldz. juː ˈhæv ə ˈfjuː ˈɑːpʃənz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm also not sure which universities to apply to.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr wɪtʃ ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz tu ˈæpli ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: First, look at the requirements. Most graduate schools need a good English test score.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ˈlʊk ət ðə rɪˈkwaɪərmənts. ˈmoʊst ˈɡrædʒuət ˌskuːlz ˈniːd ə ˈɡʊd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtɛst ˈskɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How do I know which test to take?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈnoʊ wɪtʃ ˈtɛst tə ˈteɪk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Each university's website tells you what to do.
dialogue.reading: ˈiːtʃ ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ˈwɛbsaɪt ˈtɛlz juː ˈwʌt tə ˈduː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And when should I apply? I don't know when to start.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwɛn ʃʊd aɪ ˈæpli? aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ wɛn tə ˈstɑːrt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: About a year before you want to start your studies. So start planning now!
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ə ˈjɪr bɪˈfɔːr juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈstɑːrt jʊr ˈstʌdiz. soʊ ˈstɑːrt ˈplænɪŋ ˈnaʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Now I know what to do next.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈnoʊ ˈwʌt tə ˈduː ˈnɛkst.
